evidence.text: the original at 0x2e82c holds 347 instructions and 1185 bytes; the record keeps the 1228-byte extent and sets no function size

the three callers at 0x1fecf, 0x29022, and 0x2a2a8 pass the selected track index from DAT_001203bc; the callers sit in the loading-screen, net-race-screen, and race-menu paths, so the module takes the section race_frame callees

the function inserts the lap time at DAT_0011d26c into the five slots of the 0x50-byte lap records at DAT_00120430 and, when DAT_0011d2b0 is 2, the race time at DAT_0011d268 into the race records at DAT_00120610; both tables keep the entries in ascending time order, and the screen at 0x2d4b8 reads the same two tables

a successful race insert builds %s\replays\temp.rpl, checks that the file exists, selects the first free replay number from the +0x28 flags, builds %s\replays\REPLAY%d%d.RPL from the track index and the number, deletes the target, and renames the temporary file, so the module names the function race_record_save
the input word DAT_00118e1c gates the save: the bits 0x1020 return before any table write

name: race_record_save
role: saves the current lap and race times into the two best-time tables and renames the replay file into the next free slot
